name: fight-police-squad-vs4
note: PO 10-09: 'When they start to fight, they need to move like real policemen would do, not standing still'. Three police allies (post-holding officers, handguns) and the courier against 4 chasing infected at the game camera. Look for: two-handed aim with recoil while shooting, gun lowered between targets, backstep while facing the threat, sidestep past a teammate or the courier, baton strike at arm's length, no foot sliding, body facing the target.
